QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` undefined (the default, `mbedtls_config.h:208` is commented out) | `calloc`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` controls the allocator mechanism. It also says the option is commented out in the shipped `mbedtls_config.h` (line 208), so the default is plain `calloc`.
